title: Redis Streams
subtitle: XADD, XREAD, consumer groups, and durable messaging

content.text: Streams are an append-only log of messages. Unlike Pub/Sub, messages are persisted and consumers can replay them.

content.code:
# Append an event
XADD events * action "click" button "submit"

# Read new messages (blocking)
XREAD COUNT 10 BLOCK 5000 STREAMS events $

# Consumer group (for competing consumers)
XGROUP CREATE events workers $ MKSTREAM
XREADGROUP GROUP workers consumer1 COUNT 5 STREAMS events >

# Acknowledge processed message
XACK events workers 1699100000000-0

content.definition: A named group of consumers sharing work from a stream. Each message is delivered to only one consumer in the group.

questions.question: What is the difference between Redis Streams and Pub/Sub?
options: Streams persist messages; Pub/Sub does not
questions.explanation: Streams persist messages to an append-only log; Pub/Sub messages vanish if no subscriber is connected.

faq.q: How do I process failed messages (pending)?
faq.a: Use XPENDING to find unacknowledged messages and XCLAIM to reassign them to another consumer for reprocessing.
